scope.claim: Empirical source-only CUDA measurement-noise detection envelope for the exact run authority below.

estimator.independent_unit: One completed, independently launched full-corpus epoch as defined by the frozen run authority.
estimator.upper_detection_limit: Exact observed maximum for the scalar metric in the family's frozen extrema summary.
estimator.lower_detection_limit: Exact observed minimum for the scalar metric in the family's frozen extrema summary.
estimator.claim_scope: Marginal per scalar metric within each comparison family; no simultaneous coverage claim across metrics or families.

interpretation.within_or_at_limit: The difference is not distinguishable from the measured source-only null envelope at this resolution; this is not equivalence and does not imply PASS.
interpretation.beyond_limit: The difference exceeds the measured source-only null envelope for that metric and family; this alone does not imply scientific FAIL.
